currency: annual current US dollars; illustrative accounting basis
reference_note: A round hypothetical envelope. Not an official global employer-cost total. World Bank reports 2025 world GDP of USD118.35T, and ILO reports a global labor-income share of 52.6%. Their USD62.2521T mechanical product is a scale check only: this study has not harmonized country coverage, price basis, vintages and aggregation weights.
digital_definition: Compensation attributable to task time spent performing computer-mediated work, not the full compensation of every person who ever uses a device.
technical_eligibility_note: All fractions beyond the reference envelope are scenario assumptions. The experiment supplies no worldwide eligibility fraction at its measured reliability.

cost_definitions.retained_customer_cost_fraction: Remaining employee attention, exception handling, integration and internal oversight, divided by comparable adopted-task labor expenditure; scenario assumption.
cost_definitions.service_price_fraction: Service fees paid to all providers, divided by the same adopted-task labor expenditure; not a token price.
cost_definitions.provider_operating_cost_fraction: Provider-side execution, compute and delivery support cost, divided by the same adopted-task labor expenditure; excludes companywide fixed research, sales, capital and financing costs.
cost_definitions.individual_provider_share: One provider's share of the adopted service market; arbitrary scenario input, not demonstrated market share.

accounting_warning: Potential customer economic savings are not automatically cash savings. Provider revenue is service fees, not wages displaced or savings created. Provider gross contribution is not profit. These flows must not be added as independent market sizes.
